_comment: Copy the mcpServers block into your Claude Code config (~/.claude/settings.json) or a project .mcp.json. The 'github' server uses the official remote endpoint (browser OAuth on first use, no token to paste). 'terraform' needs Docker; 'serena' needs uv/uvx (https://docs.astral.sh/uv/). 'playwright' is OPTIONAL - the bundled agent-browser skill covers most browser self-testing without any MCP config.

playwright._comment: Optional. Prefer the agent-browser skill for browser-based blueprint verification.
